learning_outcomes.text: Can read and understand a reading passage appropriate to the level.
Can use verbs commonly used in daily conversations in sentences.
Acquires knowledge about the geographical structure of Germany and learns the names of cities and countries in Europe.

syllabus_topics: Alphabet and letter groups in German, pronunciation accents
Geography knowledge, European countries and international words
International words, tools and equipment used in school, definite and indefinite articles, plural forms of nouns, negative sentences
Numbers, giving address information, present tense, auxiliary verbs
Personal and interrogative pronouns, accusative case, imperative sentences
School supplies, language use in the classroom, separable prefix verbs
Weekly lesson plan and lessons, possessive pronouns
Weekly plans, creating and presenting a dialogue independently
Sections within the school, finding directions, use of prepositions according to dative and accusative cases
Appointments, invitations, birthdays, ordinal numbers, months, seasons
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of our University Senate.
